_about: IPA for English terms that espeak gets wrong or that the main-language voices blur, as a last resort. Every entry is a correct English pronunciation, chosen with the Whisper probe among English variants; never a main-language respelling. 'say' is the same pronunciation in letters, for the check; readings that sound the same are separated by |. Word-final consonants are handled by the generic final_fix rule, not here.

kubectl.why: espeak reads it kyoo-bek-tl; Whisper heard Qbectl. 'kube control' is a common spoken form; Whisper often writes it 'cube control'

database.why: the US flap in espeak's dˈeɪɾəbeɪs was heard as d'herbe

new.why: US nˈuː was heard as noo or note

branch.why: short æ was heard as Italian branco

kubelet.why: espeak blurs it; with this IPA Whisper writes the right sound as Cubelet or Qubelet, which the check now accepts (it reported the right sound as not heard in a test video)
